title: Tor comparison from a chart to its sharp face localization
statement:
Let $P$ be a fine saturated commutative monoid [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], let $A$ be a strictly henselian local ring [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], and let $\alpha:P\to A$ be a chart of an fs log structure at its closed geometric point. Put $F=\{p\in P\mid \alpha(p)\in A^\times\}$, $P_F=\{p-f:p\in P,f\in F\}\subset P^{\rm gp}$, and $P_x=P_F/F^{\rm gp}$. Choose a monoid section $s:P_x\to P_F$ of the quotient and a sharp characteristic chart [lem-trf-log-regular-sharp-chart] $b:P_x\to A$ inducing the same characteristic identification as $\alpha$. Then there is a monoid homomorphism $u:P_x\to A^\times$ with $\alpha(s(q))=u(q)b(q)$ for every $q$. For every monoid ideal $H\subset P$, if $H_x$ is its image in $P_x$, the face localization $\mathbf Z[P]\to\mathbf Z[P_F]$, the splitting $P_F\cong P_x\oplus F^{\rm gp}$, the unit twist $z^q\mapsto u(q)z^q$, and the resulting change of rings induce a natural isomorphism of Tor groups [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules]
$$\operatorname{Tor}^{\mathbf Z[P]}_1(\mathbf Z[P]/\mathbf Z[H],A)\;\cong\;\operatorname{Tor}^{\mathbf Z[P_x]}_1(\mathbf Z[P_x]/\mathbf Z[H_x],A).$$
